statement: The University of Florida blueberry breeding programme publishes measured values for Colossus 'FL11-35' of firmness of 304 g/mm at harvest, 336 g/mm after 21 days and 286 g/mm after 49 days, berry weight averaging 2.8 g, diameter averaging 20.5 mm and average soluble solids of 12.3 degrees Brix. The firmness figures use the programme's own g/mm compression index and are not directly comparable with firmness figures produced by other methods.
